cohort: 68 women who had undergone laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy and conceived between 2007 and 2017
finding: There was no difference in pregnancy or neonatal outcomes between women who conceived at different time intervals after laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy, however there was a statistically significant trend towards increased rates of caesarean section in those with longer surgery-to-conception intervals.
birth_weight: newborn weight was measured, but no specific values given
